svg.text: A moved order must still start inside its own window. Within one event, once the first target has moved other orders, any further-moving plan for the second target is forced to

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: review, so split auto-commits cannot add up beyond one target’s limit.
